requirement:
修复订票和取消订单流程中发送通知邮件的异常。
用户反馈下单后收不到确认邮件，取消订单后也收不到通知。
经排查是邮件发送接口调用异常，需要检查相关服务的通知调用逻辑。

details.name: ts-notification-service
details.rationale: Central service for sending notifications/emails; any email sending anomaly would be fixed here.

details.name: ts-preserve-other-service
details.rationale: Handles alternative reservation flow and has similar email exception fix in commit history, likely shares notification logic.

details.name: ts-cancel-service
details.rationale: Handles order cancellation and has commit 'fix: send email exception', directly related to cancellation notification emails.

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Order service may be involved in order lifecycle and could call notification service for confirmations.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Handles other order types and may also trigger notifications for orders/cancellations.

details.name: ts-rebook-service
details.rationale: Rebooking may involve order changes and could trigger notification emails, though less directly related.

details.name: ts-execute-service
details.rationale: Executes order actions and may send notifications after successful execution, potentially affected.
